`>`); the client anchor latch (`:32095-32105` вЂ” BOTH slots copy
`Center.X / 16f`, the decompile's X/X quirk kept 1:1); the timer ladder
(`:32108-32124` вЂ” the unanchored reset, the в€’1 tick, the в€’2/в€’2 boss-life
accelerations on the INTEGER `lifeMax / 2` / `/ 4` strict thresholds, the
в€’6 retreat drain); the sibling re-arm (`:32125-32134`); the anchor search
(`:32135-32183`); the positive-anchor early return (`:32185-32188`); the
speed ladder (`:32189-32213` вЂ” 6/8/10, +1 expert, +1 expert-below-half,
Г—2 retreat, Г—2 dead, both multiplies stack); the anchor pull
(`:32214-32237` вЂ” the anchor centre `ai*16 в€’ 8`, the STRICT

`delta * (speed / dist)` normalise); the ftw thorn latch
(`:32220-32233` вЂ” `localAI[3]`, `SpawnPlanteraThorns`
(`WorldGen.cs:76113`) rides `HookEvents::spawn_thorns`); the rotation
(`:32238-32239` вЂ” `Atan2(x: bossDx, y: bossDy) в€’ 1.57f`, the named args

**RNG argument** (every draw cited, all on the caller's `UnifiedRandom` =
the `Main.rand` stream under the `UpdateNpcs` swap):
1. `Next(60, 300)` (`:32131`) вЂ” once PER matching pool slot inside the
   `!flag59 && localAI[0] <= 0 && ai[0] != 0` gate: every other active
   same-type NPC with either velocity component non-zero re-arms the
   timer; the loop does NOT break, the last match's draw wins. Zero draws
   when the gate fails or no sibling moves.
2. `Next(300, 600)` (`:32137`) вЂ” on entering the search.
3. Per attempt (1..=1001 вЂ” `num778 <= 1000` with the pre-increment,
   `:32140-32142`): two `Next(-num781, num781 + 1)` jitters (`:32156`,

4. Nothing else draws: `TargetClosest` (`:32160`) scans without

## The footstep sound wave (S1-E-21 wave D, 2026-11-18)

**Source correction:** vanilla 1.4.5.8 has NO per-tile-type player footstep
cues. The whole decompile carries no `footstep`/`StepSound` surface table and
no Snow/Stone step assets exist in `Content/Sounds` вЂ” the grass (`Grass`,
sound 6), stone (`Tink`, 21) and dig cues are the tile-break families
(`WorldGen.KillTile_PlaySounds`, wave C). The only footstep path is the
Hermes-boot fast run: `Player.SpawnFastRunParticles` (`Player.cs:20205-20216`)
plays `hermesStepSound` when `runSoundDelay == 0 && velocity.Y == 0`
(`:20212`) at `position` (the top-left, `:20214`) and re-arms
`runSoundDelay = IntendedCooldown` (`:20215`). The callers are
`HorizontalMovement`'s two 0.2x-acceleration arms past the
`(accRunSpeed + maxRunSpeed) / 2` threshold (`:19779`), grounded and
unmounted (`:19987-19990`, `:20017-20020`). `PlayerFrame` re-derives the cue
every frame: default `(SoundType 17, Style -1, Cooldown 9)`
(`:35947-35949`), the Moon Lord legs (`legs == 140`) override to
`(2, 24, 6)` (`:35959-35964`). `Player.Update` ticks the delay down
(`:24706-24708`).

The port: `Player::spawn_fast_run_particles` queues the play
(`pending_step_sound`), `update_frames` re-derives `hermes_step_sound`, the
decrement sits after `purge_immune_buffs` and before `update_frames` (the
C# order), and `world_sim/player.rs` drains the queue through
`Audio::play_step_sound` with the `UpdatePlayers` stream (`Player.Update`
runs under the `Main.cs:17754` swap). Case 17 (`LegacySoundPlayer.cs:854-864`)
plays `Sounds/Run` and rolls `Main.rand.Next(-10, 11) * 0.01` for the pitch
(`:862`, `sound::Family::Run`) вЂ” the draw runs only AFTER the attenuation
gate passed (`:369-436` precedes the switch); the int overload
(`SoundEngine.cs:102-108`) draws no `GetRandomPitch` NextFloat. The Item-24
arm delegates to wave A's `play_use_sound` faГ§ade (the audio-only
`GetRandomPitch` + the case-2 pitch draw after the gate). `Run` and
`Item_24` join `SFX_CUES`.

Deviations: the `SpawnFastRunParticles` dust trails (`:20217-20300` вЂ” the
wings-3/rocket-6, sailDash and shoe-dye arms) are visual seams, unported;
the legs-140 override is coded but unreachable вЂ” the port's `legs_armor`
has no producer yet (the C#'s `:35767` effective-legSlot assignment is part
of the unported armor visuals); the `SoundInstanceRun` stop/re-create pool
is the standing D4 (a fresh source per play). Tests
`s1_e_21d_the_fast_run_queues_the_footstep_cue_and_cooldown`,
`s1_e_21d_the_footstep_pitch_draw_rides_the_passed_stream`.

## The read-only NPC snapshot seam (S1-D-8 partial, task/S1-D-8, 2026-11-18)

Stage-2 prerequisite (research/39 "Phase A"): the NPC pass scans `app.npcs.iter()`
per scanning NPC, re-borrowing the mutable store for read-only lookups. This round
introduces the seam for ONE scan family вЂ” the carrier-link scans in
`world_sim/npcs.rs`'s `update_npcs` pre-passes (the Moon Lord parts' core lookup
`NPC.cs:41642`/`:42098`, the unlinked part's family-core/head fallback find, and the
core's part-alive check `:41251-41269`):

- `crates/tr-app/src/world_sim/npc_snapshot.rs::NpcSnapshot` вЂ” a per-tick read-only
  view built once (`NpcSnapshot::build(&app.npcs)`) before the family, copying only
  the scan-visible fields (`uid`, `kind`, `hp`, the `Npc::center()` pair). The scans
  (`position_living_uid`, `first_living_kind_uid`, `any_living_uid`) take `&self`, so
  the compiler forbids them touching the mutable store; the family's writes land on
  the scanning NPC alone.
- The one intra-family mutation the live reads could observe вЂ” the pre-pass's own
  `hp = 0` kill of a part whose core died вЂ” is mirrored by the owning pass through
  `NpcSnapshot::kill(idx)`; later scans in the family see the death exactly as the
  live `hp > 0` reads did. Centres stay valid: the family never moves an NPC.
- Behaviour frozen: no predicate, order, constant or RNG change. Proof: the existing
  Moon-Lord NPC tests, the `worldgen/world_hash.rs` pins, and two seam-equivalence
  tests (`npc_snapshot::tests::the_snapshot_scans_match_the_live_slice_scans`,
  `the_kill_mirror_matches_the_live_hp_write`) that compare every snapshot query
  against the live-slice scan it replaces. Full workspace green.
- **Left (not this round)**: the other scan families (saucer/scutlix/dutchman carrier
  scans, the projectile pool's `npcs.iter()` sites, the separation/target-selection
  families) and the spatial hash вЂ” the ROADMAP S1-D-8 row stays рџџЎ until then. No
  spatial hash was introduced; the scan count is unchanged (the seam only changes
  what the scans borrow, not how many there are).

## The NPC spatial hash + the carrier family migration (S1-D-8b, task/S1-D-8b-spatial, 2026-11-18)

The spatial slice of S1-D-8, building on the seam above:

- `crates/tr-app/src/npc_spatial.rs::NpcSpatial` вЂ” a cell-bucketed index over the
  per-tick `NpcSnapshot`: each slot buckets by its centre into a 1600 px grid
  (`CELL_PX` вЂ” an index granularity ONLY, it never enters a predicate). `near()`
  visits the conservative cell window (`k = ceil(radius / CELL_PX)` cells past the
  query cell per axis вЂ” a superset of the disc) and yields candidates in ASCENDING
  SLOT ORDER, the exact order the linear `npcs.iter()` scan visited. `hp` is not
  indexed, so the seam's kill mirror (`NpcSnapshot::kill`) stays visible without a
  rebuild.
- ONE more scan family migrated: `world_sim/npcs.rs::carrier_link_pre_pass` вЂ” the
  saucer/scutlix/dutchman carrier pre-pass (the `AI_075` type-390 nearest-carrier
  lookup, the `AI_093` Dutchman crew count, the saucer mounts' turret/cannon crew
  counts). Its 4 radius scans now read `NpcSpatial::nearest_living_kind` /
  `count_living_kind_within` over the same snapshot the Moon-Lord family uses; the
  predicates, the strict `< 1600.0` reach and the first-wins tie-break (`d < bd`)
  are verbatim. The pass mirrors its own fall-with-carrier `hp = 0` kills via
  `snap.kill`. The display inheritance stays a live write pass (it mutates other
  slots); the family runs at the same fixed-step position (extracted to a function,
  called where the inline loop stood).
- Behaviour frozen вЂ” proof: the A/B twin-seed equivalence tests.
  `npc_spatial::tests` (4 tests) compares the spatial candidate sequences against
  the linear scan slot-by-slot and distance-bit-by-bit over 4 seeds Г— 60 query
  centres Г— 8 kinds, plus exact cell-boundary/strict-reach cases (a centre exactly
  1600 px away is excluded, one at 1599.9 included), the kill-mirror visibility and
  empty/all-dead pools.
  `world_sim::npcs::tests::the_spatial_carrier_pass_matches_the_linear_scan_over_twin_seeds`
  runs the WHOLE migrated pass against the verbatim pre-migration linear scan
  (kept as the `#[cfg(test)]` reference `carrier_link_pre_pass_linear`) over
  byte-identical twin pools (4 seeds Г— 120 NPCs incl. linked/unlinked mounts, dead
  slots, cell-edge positions) and asserts every write-visible field
  (hp/carrier_x/y/timer/phase/rot/facing/crew counts) bit-for-bit equal вЂ” including
  the kill cascade. The world-hash pins stay green.
- **Left (deferred)**: the projectile pool's 18 `npcs.iter()` sites
  (`projectile.rs`), the separation/target-selection families
  (`npc.rs`/`npc_target.rs`), and the remaining `world_sim/npcs.rs` scans вЂ” the
  ROADMAP S1-D-8 row stays рџџЎ. No TR_BENCH A/B was taken this round (the slice's
  contract is the equivalence proof; the perf measurement rides the next slice).
## The join-bundle message ids (S1-I-1 wave A, 2026-11-18)

Wave A of the message-id remap ports the JOIN bundle's eleven missing ids as
wire bodies + `C2s`/`S2c` codecs in `crates/tr-app/src/net.rs` вЂ” the first
dependency tier of `SyncConnectedPlayer` (`NetMessage.cs:2806-2822`) /
`SyncOnePlayer` (`:2885-2960`) / `SendNPCHousesAndTravelShop` (`:2824-2852`) /
`SendAnglerQuest` (`:2653-2673`) /
`CreditsRollEvent.SendCreditsRollRemainingTimeToPlayer`
(`CreditsRollEvent.cs:27-33`) / `SendAllMarkersToPlayer`
(`CoinLossRevengeSystem.cs:498-507`):

- `30 TogglePVP` вЂ” `(byte)plr + hostile` (`NetMessage.cs:856-859`).
- `42 Unknown42` вЂ” the mana sync, `(byte)plr + (short)statMana + (short)statManaMax` (`:961-965`). Named `PLAYER_MANA` for readability; the C# name is `Unknown42` (`MessageID.cs:95`).
- `45 TeamChange` вЂ” `(byte)plr + (byte)team` (`:970-974`). `157 TeamChangeFromUI` shares the writer arm but its read side adds the team-based-spawn tail (`MessageBuffer.cs:2355-2363`); 157 is not a join-bundle id вЂ” its id + codec landed with wave B below.
- `60 Unknown60` вЂ” the NPC household banner, `(short)npc + (short)homeX + (short)homeY + (byte)status` (`:1067-1072`); the status is `WorldGen.TownManager.GetHouseholdStatus` (`:2845`). Named `NPC_HOUSE`.
- `72 TravelMerchantItems` вЂ” exactly `Main.TravelShopMaxSlots = 40` (`Main.cs:67029`) `(short)` item types, no count prefix (`:1134-1141`, reader `MessageBuffer.cs:3121-3124`).
- `74 AnglerQuest` вЂ” `(byte)Main.anglerQuest + anglerWhoFinishedToday.Contains(recipient name)` (`:1145-1148`); the wire's bool is per-recipient, the client stores it as `anglerQuestFinished` (`MessageBuffer.cs:3147-3153`).
- `126 SyncRevengeMarker` вЂ” `RevengeMarker.WriteSelfTo` (`CoinLossRevengeSystem.cs:275-286`): int uniqueID, Vector2 location, int npcNetID, float hpPercent, int npcType, int aiStyle, int coinsValue, float baseValue, bool spawnedFromStatue; the reader mirrors it field-for-field (`:321-324`).

- `140 SetMiscEventValues` вЂ” `(byte)kind + (int)value` (`:1591-1594`); the join bundle sends kind 0 only (the credits roll's remaining frames). Kinds 1/2 (the server-side slime transforms, `MessageBuffer.cs:4250-4260`) decode but have no port application.
- `142 SyncProjectileTrackers` вЂ” `(byte)plr` + two `TrackedProjectileReference` bodies, each `(int)Key + (short)type` (`TrackedProjectileReference.cs:22-26`/`:33-37`).
- `147 SyncLoadout` вЂ” `(byte)plr + (byte)CurrentLoadoutIndex` + the `hideVisibleAccessory` `bool[10]` (`Player.cs:1708`) packed into one `(ushort)` вЂ” bit `i` per slot (`WriteAccessoryVisibility`, `NetMessage.cs:1882-1893`; unpack `MessageBuffer.cs:4494-4501`).

Deliberate scope boundary: **bodies + codecs only**. The two `netglue`
dispatchers carry explicit parked arms for the new variants вЂ” nothing sends
them and the client/host apply-and-relay sites (`MessageBuffer.cs:1851-1867`,

- `159 RequestSection` вЂ” the writer writes two `(short)`s
  (`NetMessage.cs:1662-1665`), the reader reads two `ReadUInt16`
  (`MessageBuffer.cs:4460` в†’ `SendSection`) вЂ” same bytes for non-negative

  (`Player.cs:41534`, `WorldItem.cs:375`). The port streams unrequested
  (`host_stream_sections`); the on-request arm is S1-I-4's.

Deliberate scope boundary (same as wave A): **bodies + codecs only**. The
`netglue` dispatchers carry parked arms; the apply/relay sites
(`MessageBuffer.cs:1119-1288` incl. the spam counters `:1141-1146` and the
unsent-section fail-force `:1148-1151`, `:1299-1334`, `:2909-2948`,
`:4023-4042`, `:2355-2363`, `:4450-4462`) and the send fan-out land with
S1-I-4, so the live net message order is unchanged. The per-id round-trip
tests `net::tests::s1_i_1b_*` (8) pin the id byte, the exact C# body bytes

## The NPC-family net ids, first half (S1-I-1 d91, 2026-11-20)

The 23/24/27/28/29 region, censused against `MessageID.cs` and re-verified
byte-for-byte against `NetMessage.cs`'s writer arms + `MessageBuffer.cs`'s
readers (the second half is d92; 18/36/41/43/51/55/62/84 belong to c27):

- **`23 NPCInfo` — the body is now verbatim** (`NetMessage.cs:686-763`):
  the ai[0..4] flag-gated floats ride BEFORE the `(short)netID` (flags1
  b2..b5), the `(ushort)target` is real (was a hard 0), the life width byte
  keys on `lifeMax` (was keyed on the current life — wrong for a damaged
  high-max NPC), flags2 carries `SpawnedFromStatue`/`difficulty != 1`/
  `spawnNeedsSyncing`/the shimmer bit, the catchable kinds append the
  `releaseOwner` byte, and King Slime's position rides the
  `Size * SyncAnchor[50]` offset (`NPCID.cs:10457` — the only non-zero row).
  The wire `kind` stays the port-local protocol id, so both per-type
  predicates map through `cs_id` (the `NPCID.Count` bounds gate included).
  Remaining defaults: the player-count scaling byte (flags2 b0) is consumed
  on decode but never written (no multiplayer stat scaling yet), and
  `difficulty` rides 1.0 until the world-mode state is persisted. The
  SyncAnchor uses the kind's base `size()`, not King Slime's hp-scaled live
  `Size` (the wire snapshot carries no scale). The client apply arm now
  lands target/directionY/spriteDirection/ai/statue/shimmer/releaseOwner
  (`MessageBuffer.cs:1649-1699`); the pending-damage merge (`GetPendingDamage`,
  `:1668-1676`) stays an I-4 follow-up.
- **`24 UnusedMeleeStrike` — dead, deliberately unported.** The writer arm
  exists (`NetMessage.cs:765-768`: `(short)number + (byte)number2`) but no
  `SendData(24)` call site exists anywhere in the decompilation, and the
  reader is `Invariant.Assert(condition: false, "UnusedMeleeStrike")`
  (`MessageBuffer.cs:1706-1708`). The census's "no body arm" claim was
  wrong about the writer; the id is still dead on the wire.
- **`27 SyncProjectile` — re-verified verbatim** (`NetMessage.cs:776-841`):
  key, position, velocity, `(short)type`, flags1, the optional flags2 byte
  (ai[2] present), then ai0/ai1/banner/damage/knockBack/originalDamage/ai2
  in flag order. The existing codec already matched; a byte-pin test now
  locks it. `bannerIdToRespondTo` still rides 0 from the pool (no banner
  field yet, `net_proj_sync.rs::state_of`).
- **`28 DamageNPC` — re-verified verbatim** (`NetMessage.cs:844-850`):
  `(byte)slot`, generation, `(short)damage`, knockback float,
  `(byte)(hitDirection + 1)`, `(byte)crit`. The `-1` direction sentinel
  wraps through the byte and back (`MessageBuffer.cs:1776`). Byte-pin test.
- **`29 KillProjectile` — the position now rides both directions**
  (`NetMessage.cs:852-855`: `(int)key + Vector2`). The C2s body used to
  hard-write NaN/NaN and drop the received position; now the client's
  Kill-tail sends the ENTRY-position snapshot (`Projectile.cs:77256`, the
  `ProjSend::Kill { key, x, y }` the decision layer already produced) and
  the host relays the received position verbatim (`MessageBuffer.cs:1847`).
  A finite position snaps the slot before the kill, NaN/Inf deactivates
  silently (`:1835-1843`) — `projectile.rs::kill_remote_at`. The NaN
  owner-lost despawn (`Projectile.cs:16697`) still rides NaN bit-exact.

Six byte-pin tests `net::tests::s1_i_1_npc_info_*` /
`s1_i_1_projectile_verbatim_body` / `s1_i_1_npc_strike_verbatim_body` /
`s1_i_1_projectile_dead_verbatim_body` lock the id bytes + the exact C#
body bytes + the round trips (written, not run — the lane is code-only).

## The buff misc block (S1-E-7 wave D, 2026-11-18)

accumulator (the wave-B `buff_effects.rs` pattern), so the module is
disjoint from waves A/B/C вЂ” no `player.rs`/`buffs.rs` edits, the buff
timer engine untouched. Deliberate deviations:

- **Wiring deferred**: the accumulator is not yet copied onto the live
  `Player` fields вЂ” the `player.rs` scan wiring is the waves' merge step
  (same admission as wave B's `DebuffEffects`). Until then the module is
  test-only; no runtime behaviour changes.
- **Pet spawns are requests**: `pet_spawns` records `(kind, dx)` at the
  entity centre (the buff-341 В±10В·direction offset, `:12242-12253`); the
  `NewProjectile` call itself rides the wiring step (the pet projectile
  AIs/draw are M4-PROJ territory). The spawn GATE (owned count == 0) is exact
  from the `UpdateProjectileCaches` recount.
- **Crystal Leaf dedupe**: the arm's kill-every-226-beyond-the-first pool
  walk (`:11663-11673`) is recorded as `crystal_leaf_dedupe`; the walk
  rides the wiring step. The count gates (spawn at 0, dedupe at >1) are exact.
- **Rabid's RNG** (`:11324-11327`): the `Next(1200)` в†’ `Next(6)` в†’
  `Next(60,100)` triple rides the caller's `UnifiedRandom` in the C#
  order; the two inner draws happen ONLY on the 1/1200 hit. Tests mirror the
  stream and check the truncating `(int)(60f * scale * mult)` durations.
- **Shimmering's tile scan** (`:11807-11816`) is ported verbatim against a
  caller-supplied `SolidTile3` predicate (the table stays world-free); the
  underworld-layer gate and the 60/6/DelBuff outcomes are exact.
- **Webbed** records the full lockdown (velocity epsilon, jumpHeight 0,
  gravity 0, moveSpeed 0, dash/dashType 0, noKnockback, hook removal) as
  accumulator fields; the existing `player.rs` webbed arm keeps its
  current behaviour until the wiring step reconciles the two.
- **WellFed/hunger `pickSpeed` sign**: the deltas are kept signed like the
  C# (WellFed subtracts, Hungry/Starving add вЂ” a lower pickSpeed mines
  faster); the wiring step maps them onto `pick_speed_bonus` with the

- **Midas (72)** has no `UpdateBuffs` arm (NPC-side debuff); the flask

## The first missing buff block (W4-c16, code-only mode, 2026-11-20)

`crates/tr-app/src/buff_effects_orbs.rs` ports the FIRST contiguous region of
`Player.UpdateBuffs` whose arms had no live effect anywhere in the port: the
SugarRush/BrainOfConfusion stragglers (`Player.cs:9935-9947`) and the
ManaHeat/lunar-orb tail (`:10328-10461`), 21 ids — 192, 321, 396, 95-100
(beetle), 170-172 (solar), 173-181 (nebula). The live-set census
(`docs/research/W4-c16-buff-effects-wave-b.md`) diffed every `buffType[j]`
head/band in `:9855-12069` against ALL live paths (the `player.rs` wave-A
match, the summon keep-alives, the wired wave-C accessory pass, the DoT
`holding()` derivation, the regen fold, the light feed) — the remaining
"missing" ids are the unwired wave-B/D tables' own claims, out of scope.

Pure accumulator (the B/D seam): `apply_orb_effect_arm` folds one slot's
writes into `OrbEffects`; the wiring (the merge step) copies the fields and
drains the per-slot requests IN SLOT ORDER. Deliberate deviations:

- **Wiring deferred** — same admission as waves B/D: test-only until the
  merge; no runtime behaviour changes. The ManaHeat consumer
  (`magicDamage *= manaHeat`, `:25906`) already runs via
  `potions::apply_magic_damage_sickness_tail`; the grant side
  (`try_apply_mana_heat`, the mana-star pickup lane) is live — only the
  per-tick decay arm was missing, and it now ports here.
- **Sequential orb state** — the caller SEEDS `beetle_orbs`/`solar_shields`
  from the live fields; the arms read + assign per slot (the wave-B `thorns`
  pattern), matching the C#'s live `this.beetleOrbs` reads mid-chain.
- **The reconcile quirk is preserved** — the upgrade branch's m-loop band is
  INCLUSIVE of the current slot's id (`:10357` `<= 95 + num8 - 1`), so the
  C# deletes the very slot it is processing and does NOT `j--` afterwards
  (the shifted-in buff skips its arm this tick). The accumulator records
  `purge_band = (base, base + tier - 1)` and the wiring replicates the m-loop
  verbatim. The downgrade branch (`current > tier`) self-deletes WITH the
  `j--` rescan; the count assignment (`:10365`/`:10400`/`:10430`) still runs
  after either branch, exactly like the source.
- **Set gates constants-off** — `beetleDefense`/`beetleOffense`/`setSolar`
  come from `ApplySetBonus_BeetleDefense`/`_BeetleDamage`/`_Solar`
  (`:16499-16535`/`:16366-16369`, unported). With the flags false the arms
  zero the orbs/shields and DelBuff the slot — the C#'s own behaviour without
  the set bonus. BeetleMight's stat adds land BEFORE the gate (`:10431-10432`
  precede `:10433`), so a single tick of +0.1·tier melee damage/speed applies
  even without the set, verbatim.
- **Nebula downgrade** — `UpdateBuffs_NebulaBuffs` (`:12070-12079`) ports as
  `nebula_level`: at `buffTime == 2` with level > 1 the tier steps down
  (`buffType[b]--`, `buffTime[b] = 480`) and the stat add reads the
  POST-downgrade level (`:10451`/`:10456` run after the ref call). The
  `buff_type_decrement` request rides the wiring. The mana-level consumer
  (`UpdateManaRegen` `:19567-19583`) stays its own lane.
- **SugarRush pickSpeed sign** — kept raw C# (−0.2); the wiring maps onto the
  port's positive `pick_speed_bonus` convention (+0.2), like wave D's WellFed
  rows.
- **ManaHeat duration guard** — the `latestManaPotionDuration == 0f → 1f`
  write (`:10333`) is a PLAYER-field mutation mid-arm; the accumulator
  records `mana_potion_duration_reset` so the wiring applies it before the
  next slot (a second 396 slot divides by 1, like the C#). The
  `if (0f == 0f)` branch (`:10336`) is constants-true — folded.

**RNG census: ZERO draws.** Every arm is arithmetic + slot bookkeeping — no
`Main.rand` call in `:9935-9947` or `:10328-10461` (verified per body). The
block is stream-neutral by construction; the `UpdatePlayers` stream cannot
move.

Tests: 18 `w4_c16_*` witnesses (written, **not run** — code-only mode), one
per id plus the reconcile branches (upgrade purge-band inclusive quirk,
downgrade self-delete, equal-tier skip), the nebula time-2 downgrade, the
ManaHeat duration-0 guard, per-slot stacking and the out-of-range rejection.

## Frost Moon boss wiring (S1-F-13c, W1-1 resolved, code-only mode, 2026-11-19)

`task/S1-F-13c-wire-bosses` wires the three Frost Moon bosses — **Everscream
(344, aiStyle 57)**, **IceQueen (345, aiStyle 60)** and **SantaNK1 (346,
aiStyle 61)** — onto their faithful named machines. The verifier finding
**W1-1** was that the live bosses still routed to the `update_hover`
stand-ins (`npc.rs`'s kind arms), so the slice-C machines
(`npc_ai_frost_boss.rs` 3ce99f36, `npc_ai_frost_boss_b.rs` 8e216a35) were
DEAD CODE: the bosses never attacked and the RNG stream desynced ~4-15
draws/tick. **Code-only mode**: no compiler invoked; the wiring witnesses
are WRITTEN, NOT RUN.

- **The style-axis claim** (`npc.rs::update_rng_dust`): the aiStyle match
  gains three kind-gated arms — `57 if kind == Everscream`, `60 if kind ==
  IceQueen`, `61 if kind == SantaNK1` — mirroring the MourningWood/Pumpking
  precedent (`57 if kind == MourningWood`). aiStyle 57 is SHARED (325/344),
  so the Everscream claim is kind-gated; 60/61 are each their style's only
  user. The kind-match (`update_kind_ai`) arms for the three bosses are now
  `unreachable!("… rides the style axis (S1-F-13c wiring)")` guards — the
  hover stand-ins retired.
- **The dust seam** (`Npc::update_rng_dust`): the Everscream's per-tick dust
  arm (`NPC.cs:32821-32825`) rolls `Main.rand` through the verbatim
  `DustPool::new_dust`, which needs the live `Main.dust` pool + the
  `SpawnCtx` statics. `update_rng` now delegates to `update_rng_dust` with a
  scratch pool + a permissive ctx (the tests' path — the AI-level draws
  still ride the caller's stream); the live sim
  (`world_sim/npcs.rs::update_npcs`) threads `app.dust` + the frame's

## The Detonating Bubble (S1-D-3 aiStyle-70, code-only)

`crates/tr-app/src/npc_ai_style70.rs` ports `NPC.AI()`'s aiStyle-70 arm
(`NPC.cs:34884-34957`) as an UNWIRED pure module (the spore precedent,
commit 613aac92). Code-only round: no cargo/rustc/rustfmt/tests invoked;
the 13 witness tests are written, not run.

**Family identity.** Exactly one `SetDefaults` row sets `aiStyle = 70`
in `NPC.cs`: the DetonatingBubble 371 (`NPCID.cs:11419`, row
`NPC.cs:13719-13733` — 36x36, damage 100, defense 0, lifeMax 1,
NPCHit3/NPCDeath3, noGravity + noTileCollide, knockBackResist 0,
alpha 255). The arm has no per-type branch. `Projectile.cs:4861`'s
aiStyle 70 is the Flairon Bubble projectile (S1-D-4b-1,
`projectile.rs::ai_flairon_bubble`) — a different system, untouched.
The bubble spawns only from `AI_069_DukeFishron` phase 3 (`:49246`)
and phase 7 (`:49477-49481`).

**RNG by construction.** `ai_style70` takes the `Main.rand` analogue:
- the `target == 255` init gate (`:34886`) draws four, in order:
  `Next(80,121)` (`:34889`), `Next(165,265)` (`:34890`),
  `Next(-100,101)` X then Y (`:34891`, ctor argument order) — after the
  RNG-free `TargetClosest` (`:77652-77781`). The phase-7 spawn presets
  `target`/`velocity`/`ai[3]` (its own `Next(80,121)` at `:49481`), so
  those bubbles short-circuit the whole block — zero init draws.
- every tick, including the detonation tick (the draws precede the
  fuse's early return): `Next(-10,11)` for the wind X blend (`:34903`)
  then `Next(-10,11)` for the Y blend (`:34904`).
- everything else is RNG-free: `EncourageDespawn` (`:7249-7256`), the
  scan/fuse/grow, `checkDead`/`PrepareForDeathAnimation`
  (`:78032-78051`; `SetStrikePhaseChange` `:90695-90701` is
  netMode==1-only), and `UpdateNPC_CastLights` has no 371 arm.
The stream witness tests replay a twin `UnifiedRandom` by hand across
the init/steady/death ticks (written, not run).

**Deliberate skips / seams (wiring wave):**
- The `HitEffect` 371 arm (`:84229-84256`): the tracked sound
  (`PlaySound(4,x,y,3)`) and the 60-dust type-212 death burst are
  skipped WHOLESALE (the dust system is unported — the spore
  precedent), so the arm draws nothing here. `bubble_hit_effect_plan`
  carries the branch structure only. The wiring wave's draw order per
  dust: `NextDouble()` + `Next(24,41)` (`:84238` — the `vector18` pair
  is dead code but the draws HAPPEN), the `Dust.NewDust` internals,
  `Next(45,91)` for dusts 30..59 only (`:84243-84250`), `NextDouble()`
  for the hue (`:84251`). The generic prologue is inert for 371 and the
  final else-chain returns at `:89813-89815` — no generic dust.
- `Npc` has no `justHit` field (C# `:81274` set / `:90516` clear) — a
  parameter; `Main.windSpeedCurrent` rides `Wind::speed_current` — a
  parameter. The detonation returns `Style70Outcome::detonated` with
  `hp = 0`; the caller owes the HitEffect death arm + slot deactivation
  (the C# `active = false` + return, NO checkDead on that path).
- A STRUCK bubble goes through `bubble_check_dead` (the `checkDead`
  371 arm `:78046-78051` + `PrepareForDeathAnimation` `:78032-78038`):
  ai[0]=1/ai[1]=4, life restored to lifeMax, dontTakeDamage, netUpdate
  — the strike starts the 4-tick countdown, it does not kill.
- The C# `alpha` is an int (`alpha -= 30` can go negative); the port's
  u8 saturates — moot, the unconditional `alpha = 50` (`:34902`)
  overwrites both paths every tick (the fade + clamp are dead code,
  ported dead with citations).
- `Vector2.Normalize` on a zero vector is NaN in XNA; the port uses
  `normalize_or_zero` (the established projectile.rs convention).
  Reachable only when the player centre exactly equals the bubble
  centre.
- FindFrame case 371 (`:72138-72142`) pins frame row 1
  (`npcFrameCount[371] = 2`, `Main.cs:67121`) — consts pin both; the
  wiring caller sets `frame = 1`.
- Difficulty: 371 is in `NeedsExpertScaling` AND `ProjectileNPC`
  (`NPCID.cs:10447-10448`) — `ScaleStats` runs but the lifeMax<6 bump
  is skipped (`:18160-18163`, the 1-HP life survives); the expert
  damage factor is 0.75 with lifeMax untouched (`:18417-18424`, the
  `type != 371` gate). The port is single-difficulty normal; the
  wiring wave carries the expert rows.
## The Sharkron pair (S1-D-3 aiStyle-71, code-only, 2026-11-19)

`crates/tr-app/src/npc_ai_style71.rs` ports `NPC.AI()`'s
`else if (this.aiStyle == 71)` arm (`NPC.cs:34958-35079`) as a pure
module — CODE-ONLY MODE: no cargo/rustc/rustfmt/tests invoked; the 13
witness tests are written, not run. The family is the Sharkron 372 /
Sharkron2 373 (`ID/NPCID.cs:11421`/`:11423`), Duke Fishron's
sharknados' sharks; the 371 DetonatingBubble beside them rides
aiStyle **70** (`NPC.cs:13723`) and is NOT this arm. The *projectile*
aiStyle 71 (the Razorblade Typhoon, `Projectile.cs:30355-30454`,
already `ai_typhoon`) is a different system, untouched.

**The machine, verbatim:** `noTileCollide = true` (`:34960`); the
unset/dead-target re-pick is `TargetClosest(faceTarget: false)` then
`direction = 1` + netUpdate (`:34962-34967`) — the forced right
facing AFTER the selection is load-bearing for the sway's sign.
Phase 0 (`:34968-35025`): `ai[1]++`, noGravity, dontTakeDamage,
`velocity.Y = ai[3]` EVERY tick — the plain Sharkron's spawner passes
no ai3 (0 → it hovers), the Sharkron2's passes −1.5 (it rises). The
373-only sway (`:34976-35003`): the π/30·localAI[1] cosine scaled by
`ai[2]` (the spawner's projectile width, `Projectile.cs:29514`), the
undo-then-advance-then-apply double position add across the
`localAI[1]++`, the |cos−0.5| > 0.25 spriteDirection write (cos−0.5
>= 0 → −1), the `vy·spriteDirection·0.1` rotation with the two
sequential ±0.2 clamps and the alpha −6 fade-in. The C# subtracts
0.5 in DOUBLE before the float cast and compares the DOUBLE in the
sprite gate — the port casts the f32 product up to f64 for the
cosine and keeps the double through the comparisons. At
`ai[1] >= 90` (`:35004-35024`): phase 1, `ai[1] = 0` bumped to 1 iff
the box is NOT in solid tiles, the roar (sound 4 style 19 — an
outcome flag), `TargetClosest()` (faceTarget true),
`spriteDirection = direction`, `velocity = Normalize(playerCenter −
Center)·16` (the port's house `normalize_or_zero`, the XNA
reciprocal-multiply form), `rotation = ToRotation()` (+π when
direction −1), netUpdate. Phase 1 (`:35026-35078`): any other phase
RETURNS; free air floors `ai[1]` at 1, embedded fades alpha −15 with
the 150 floor; once armed (`ai[1] >= 1`): alpha −60 floor 0,
dontTakeDamage = false, `ai[1]++`, and the SECOND solid check kills
(`life = 0`, HitEffect, `active = false`, return — no `checkDead`,
the vanilla deactivates directly). `ai[1] >= 60` returns gravity;
the rotation rides the live velocity every phase-1 tick.

**RNG by construction:** the arm contains no `Next`/`NextFloat`
(`NPC.cs:34958-35079`), and `TargetClosest`/`TryTrackingTarget`/
`SetTargetTrackingValues` (`:77652-77781`, the `npc_target.rs` port,
reused UNMODIFIED) draw nothing — so `ai_style71` takes no RNG
parameter and the `the_style71_arm_draws_no_rng` witness pins a
seeded `UnifiedRandom` across a full 200-tick lifecycle of both
kinds. The `HitEffect` arm (`:84207-84228` — the dmg/lifeMax·100
type-5 dust loop on hit, the flat 75 + the 583/577/578/579 gore
burst on death) draws only inside `Dust.NewDust`/`Gore.NewGore`;
the NPC dust/gore call sites are unported (S1-E-4's remainder), so
the arm is skipped wholesale (the `npc_lights.rs` precedent — the
stream stays untouched) and `sharkron_hit_dust_plan` ports the
branch structure/counts only. The sounds draw no `Main.rand`.

**Wiring deferred** (the `npc_ai_style50.rs` precedent, 613aac92):
the roster has no Sharkron kinds, so the aiStyle axis
(the `match self.kind.ai_style()` block in `npc.rs::update_rng`)
has no style-71 arm to claim; one-line `mod` seam
only. `Npc` has no `no_tile_collide`/`no_gravity` fields — the
per-tick writes ride `Style71Outcome` for the wiring caller's
movement step (`NPC.cs:90490-90498`); the tile kill sets `hp = 0`
and returns `died_in_tiles` (the caller owes the DeathSound, the
dust/gore plan and the deactivation). `FindFrame` case 371/372/373
(`:72138-72142`) pins `frame.Y = num` — the SECOND row forever
(`SHARKRON_FRAME_ROW = 1`); `npcFrameCount[372] = [373] = 2`
(`Main.cs:67121`, the 370-379 row of the `:67082` array). The
expert/master tweaks (`ScaleStats_ByDifficulty_Tweaks`,
`:18417-18424`: damage ×0.75 for 372/373, knockback ×0.75 for the
371/372/373 group) ride the difficulty system, not this arm — the
consts are the normal-mode `SetDefaults` rows. The spawner itself
(the sharknado projectile aiStyle-64 arm, `Projectile.cs:29419-
29533`: every 4th bolt — 2nd for the Greater Sharknado 386 — spawns
a shark with the projectile's velocity, the 386 alone seeding
`ai[2] = width` / `ai[3] = −1.5`) is the projectile family's wiring
wave; the module documents the seed contract.

`origin/task/S1-D-3-aistyle71` 80fcb43b — the two minion branches were
unmerged; the octopus merge's only conflicts were keep-both doc appends
(anchors.txt, ANALYSIS.md), resolved by keeping both sections. The

cargo/rustc/rustfmt/tests/dotnet/graphify invoked; the 8 wiring witnesses
(`world_sim/npcs.rs::fishron_wiring_tests`) are WRITTEN NOT RUN.

(`NPC.cs:34880-34883`/`:34884`/`:34958`); the kind match keeps

## The aiStyle-3 velocity ladder (S1-D-3, code-only mode)

`crates/tr-app/src/npc_ai3_speeds.rs::apply_ladder` ports `AI_003_Fighters`'
per-type velocity ladder (`NPC.cs:57403-58401`) arm-for-arm in the C#'s
if-else order. The C# runs it after the shared target/stuck core
(`:57120-57402`) and before the lighting block (`:58402+`) and the position
integration; the port wires it at the same position вЂ” `npc_ai.rs`'s
`walker_step_ladder` sets the facing/sprite (the target-core stand-in), runs
the ladder in place of the direct `vx = facing * speed` write, then
integrates (`walker_integrate`, extracted verbatim from `walker_step`);
`npc.rs::update_zombie` calls `run_ai3_ladder` at the same slot. Converted
sites: zombie, skeleton (the cave walkers, the goblin fighters, the martian
ground group, the pirates, the scarecrows and the Splinterling all ride it),
scutlix, solar drakomire, solar selenian, vortex headcrab, vortex rifleman,
goblin, solar spearman, vortex soldier. The gate is `kind.ai_style() == 3`
plus the ladder's own coverage вЂ” a declined kind (non-style-3, the frost
block, the shooter exclusions) falls back to the direct write, so every
other caller's behaviour is byte-identical.

**RNG: none.** The whole block draws no `Main.rand` value вЂ” every arm is
deterministic arithmetic on velocity/direction/scale/life/target-centre.
(The shooter block `:59069+` draws `Next(-40, 41)` per axis; it is out of
this module.) The 18 test fns pin each arm's constants to the C# literals;
they were **written, not run** вЂ” this task ran in code-only mode (no
cargo/rustc/rustfmt/test invocation, no compiler invoked).

committed on this branch on top of `58b4310a`, so the branch is a
superset of its findframe name: frames + kinds together. It adds the 24

`NPC.cs` type arm), the bestiary entries, sounds/buffs, the sprite-sheet
rows (`assets.rs`, `render/entities.rs`), the netglue rows and the
`find_frame` wiring above. **Net-id verification (the note's suspicion
resolved)**: the sequential `to_u16`/`from_u16` ids 189..212 are the
PORT-LOCAL protocol space (the established `S1-F-1` bijection pattern вЂ”
e.g. `Skeleton => 6` while `NPCID.Skeleton` is 21), NOT vanilla net ids;
the band was free on main (the highest prior id was 188 MartianDrone)
and both tables carry `#[deny(unreachable_patterns)]`. The true
`.wld`/spawn net ids ride `bestiary.rs`'s `net_id` rows, and all 24 were
verified equal to the `NPCID.cs` constants (16/52/53/59/71/81/132/138/
147/161/183/184/186/187/188/189/190/191/192/193/194/200/223/225).

The 736/737/738 `BlueDungeonDebris`/`GreenDungeonDebris`/`PinkDungeonDebris`
rows, the aiStyle-10 `AI_010` arm (`Projectile.cs:57826-58100`, dispatch
`:24367-24370`), the `HandleMovement` collision tail (`:17592-17597`) and the
`Kill_ExplodeTiles` death crack (`:77369-77385`) are ported for the trio only
(`ai_dungeon_debris` + `debris_death_crack` in `projectile.rs`, rows + the
`DUNGEON_DEBRIS` set + the 3-frame `proj_frames` arm in `projectile/data.rs`).
Written in **code-only mode**: tests-as-code (`s1_d_5_debris_tests`, 7 tests)
are written but NOT run вЂ” no compiler invoked. Deviations:
- **Damage model.** The C# stock `friendly`/`hostile` are both false
  (`SetDefaults` `:788`/`:764`; the `:7748-7755` arm touches neither), so the
  debris damages nothing: `Damage_PVE_Inner` refuses `!friendly` (`:12611`),
  `Damage_EVP` refuses `!hostile` (`:14775`), `CutTiles` needs friendly
  (`:12500`). The pool's slot default is `friendly = true`, so the arm holds
  `friendly = false` explicitly (the `ai_spectre_wrath` precedent) and both
  damage proxies are kind-gated on `DUNGEON_DEBRIS`: the `damage_player`
  `!friendly` call site and the `damage_pve` NPC walk. The blocked-move
  tile-cut prologue (`:17910`/`:17948`, gate `(friendly || hostile) &&
  damage > 0`) is therefore false for the trio вЂ” the whole chain including
  its `Next(3)` draw is skipped, stream-exact (the sentry precedent).
- **Movement tail.** `HandleMovement`'s trio arm takes the plain
  `Collision.TileCollision(pos, vel, w, h, flag6, flag6)` with `flag6 = true`
  (`:17478`; the trio is NOT in `FallingBlockDoesNotFallThroughPlatforms`,
  `ProjectileID.cs:433` вЂ” platforms block it). A blocked move falls through
  the per-type chain to the default `position += velocity; Kill()`
  (`:19849-19853`). The port rides the `kill_step` stand-in (the
  `ai_sharp_tears`/`ai_leaf_blower` house pattern): a per-axis destination
  probe via `player::collides_rect`, `pos += vel` always, death on hit. The
  swept-collision zeroing of the blocked axis (the C# velocity survives as 0
  on that axis for the death frame) may differ by the swept span in the
  death pixel вЂ” the recorded stand-in cost, same as the siblings.
- **Tile walk.** The owner's breakable set (185-187/165/12/665/639/105/178)
  dies through `tr_core::edit::kill_tile(world, tx, ty, false)` (the cascading
  `KillTile` port). The top-slope flatten is `set_slope(0)` + clear
  `FLAG_HALF_BRICK` + `pos.y -= 16` (the `slope_tile_flatten` shape,
  `tileobject.rs`); `WorldGen.SlopeTile`'s `CanPoundTile` gate
  (`WorldGen.cs:80695-80743`) has no port вЂ” the flatten is unconditional, and
  the fail-dust/sound/net tails are skipped.
- **Dust/sound skips.** The trail's `Next(40)` gate roll (`:57929`) stays on
  the stream (state-bearing census); the taken-branch `Dust.NewDust`
  (type в€’ 736 + 275) and its internal draws are SKIPPED wholly (the
  `gem_bolt_aoe` convention, not the leaf-blower draws-kept one вЂ” the trio's
  dust carries no state the port reads). The death arm's `SoundID.Item127`
  and 3Г— dust are likewise skipped; the crack `Next(2)` roll stays and keeps
  the C# short-circuit order (active && `SET_CRACKED_BRICKS` && roll,
  `:77376-77385`). `noDropItem` is stock false (`:746`) and never set for the
  trio вЂ” the outer gate is unported. `netUpdate` (`:57994`) skipped (no MP).
- **Dispatch scope.** The `10 =>` arm is total for aiStyle 10 but kind-gated
  to the trio; the sand family (42/65/68/354) keeps riding the pool's
  falling-tile tail and the row-less kinds (109/411-414/1081) never dispatch
  вЂ” unchanged behaviour. `Damage_CanDealDamage`'s aiStyle-10/`localAI[1] ==
  -1` gate (`:12456`) is unreachable: the arm pins `localAI[1] = 0` every
  tick (`:57952`).
- **Spawner unwired.** `WorldGen.cs:63839-63850` (the cracked-brick break
  spawns type = tile в€’ 481 + 736, damage 20, kb 0, vel (0, 0.41) at the tile
  centre, owner `myPlayer`) is separate scope; the rows make the kinds
  spawnable and drawable (`spawnable_kinds` packs the verified
  `Projectile_736/737/738.xnb` sheets, `proj_frames = 3` per
  `Main.cs:8445-8447`).

**Code-only mode.** This round ran with NO compiler invoked вЂ” no cargo,
rustc, rustfmt, dotnet or test runs; only file reads/writes and git. The
behaviour-frozen refactor proof is therefore a **mechanical byte-proof**, not
a test run: every moved line was extracted from the `origin/main` blob
(`git show origin/main:crates/tr-core/src/edit.rs`, LF-normalized; the
worktree copy is CRLF and content-identical, verified line-by-line before

suite) is **deferred to the merge gate** per the task contract.
**The move.** `edit.rs` 6 695 в†’ 2 027 lines; the kill family lands in
`edit/kill.rs` (4 703 lines): the event records (`ObjectDrop`, `PotEvent`,

DW-2.x herb/sunflower/pot/pile/clay-pot arms, the sound table and the orb
tests). Stays in the parent: `WALL_UNBREAKABLE`, `ALCH_SOILS` (shared with

   lines;
4. kept-line count conservation (2 032 kept + 9 re-export lines).

written `kill.rs` and re-compared them to the blob: identical.

  `*= 0.5f` (`(int)(byte * 0.5)`) вЂ” two separate byte quantisations, never
  one combined float multiply; the final overlay is
  `Color(255,255,255,0) * 0.1f` в†’ (25,25,25,0). `xna_multiply_rgba` /
  `xna_scale_color` are the reusable helpers.
- **invisibleBlock bit unported**: the side-fill gates read
  `Tile.invisibleBlock()` (`Tile.cs:528-531`, `bTileHeader3 & 0x20`); the
  port's `Tile` has no `bTileHeader3`, so `FillNeighbor.invisible` reads
  `false` (the vanilla default for non-echo-coated tiles). The
  `shouldShowInvisibleBlocks` flag is threaded through the decision fn.
- **Behind-tiles layer**: `SetLayer(Layer_BehindTiles, вЂ¦)` has no port
  analogue yet (the S1-G-13 target family is unwired);
  `PlatformSideFill.behind_tiles` records the decision and the push draws
  into the world range until the wiring step routes it.
- **Sun orb / weapon-rack draws**: the anchor/origin/scale maths are exact
  (integer `Width()/2` origins, `pos - origin*scale` top-left); the texture
  decodes (`TextureAssets.SunOrb`, the item sheets) and
  `Main.sunCircle`/`mouseTextColor` are caller inputs. The additive alpha-0
  tints ride the port's existing blend deviation (S1-G-3).

## The world-sounds wave (S1-E-21i, 2026-11-18)

no cargo/rustc/rustfmt, no test runs, no graphify refresh (the Lead's task
constraint). The seven `s1_e_21i_*` witness tests are WRITTEN, NOT RUN; the
branch `task/S1-E-21i-world-sounds` is pushed unmerged for a verification pass.

### Census (what this wave covers, what it skips)

The WorldGen/Wiring world-event `PlaySound` sites, after the landed waves
(item-use A, tile-place B, NPC-hit C, footsteps D, tile-break table S1-E-21c)
and the sibling-owned scopes (ambience E21e, player E21f, NPC E21g, projectile

### The plays and their RNG streams

Every play gates attenuation FIRST (`LegacySoundPlayer.cs:369-436` precedes
the type switch) and only then draws; the draws ride the CALLER's `Main.rand`
stage stream, never the wiring stand-in `Wiring::rand` (that stream is the
device-effects substitute вЂ” cannons/traps/teleport rolls):

| Site | C# | Stream |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hammer wall break | `Player.PickWall` `Player.cs:45949` | `UpdatePlayers` (`Main.cs:17754`) |
| Player switch bridge / minecart trip / tile-use click | `Collision.SwitchTiles` (`Player.cs:28274`), `Minecart.HitTrackSwitch` (`Minecart.cs:1281-1288`), `Player.cs:32174-32178` | `UpdatePlayers` |
| Weighted pressure plates | `PressurePlateHelper.Update` (`Main.cs:17763-17765`) | `UpdatePressurePlates` |
| NPC switch bridge | `NPC.cs:90504` | `UpdateNPCs` (`Main.cs:17767`) |
| Wiring tick (timer expiries) + logic sensors | `Wiring.UpdateMech` (`WorldGen.cs:71509`) + `TileEntity.PerformUpdates` (`:71510`) inside `UpdateWorld` | `UpdateWorldGen` (`Main.cs:17802-17805`) |
| Net replays (`17` wall break `MessageBuffer.cs:1177`, `59` switch `:2682-2693`, the rigged chest `:1887-1893`) | message handlers run outside every swap (`Main.cs:16895` NpcStrike precedent) | `rngs.global()` (the bare stream) |

The case maths, per arm:

- **13 Shatter** (`:783-792`): NO draws, no pitch.
- **6 Grass** (`:706-716`): one `Next(-30, 31) * 0.01` (`:714`) вЂ”
  `sound::Family::Grass`.
- **3 style 25** (`SoundID.NPCHit25`, `SoundID.cs:1281`): wave C's style
  faГ§ade вЂ” the audio-only `GetRandomPitch` NextFloat (drawn even at variance
  0, `SoundEngine.cs:99`), the Г—0.5 volume arm and one `Next(-10, 11)` pitch
  draw (`:670`), delegated to `play_npc_hit_sound("NPC_Hit_25", вЂ¦)`.
- **0 Dig** (`:440-452`): wave B's case-0 path вЂ” the `Next(3)` variation pick
  + `Next(-10, 11) * 0.01`, delegated to `play_place_sound((0, 1), вЂ¦)`.
- **8/9 doors** (`:728-749`): one shared `Next(-20, 21) * 0.01`
  (`:736`/`:747`) вЂ” `sound::Family::Door`. The int overload
  (`SoundEngine.cs:102-108`) draws NO `GetRandomPitch`.
- **28 Mech** (`:997-1007`): the `SoundInstanceMech[0].State == Playing`
  guard (`:998-1001`) returns BEFORE the one `Next(-10, 11) * 0.01` (`:1005`)
  вЂ” `sound::mech_case28(playing_0, rng)`. The play overwrites the slot
  WITHOUT a Stop (`:1002`); the port models the slot as
  `mech_slots: [Option<Sink>; 1]` and detaches the old sink. `Mech_0` joins
  `SFX_CUES` (id 28; `SoundMech[0]` loads `Sounds/Mech_0`,
  `LegacySoundPlayer.cs:22`/`:176`).

The wiring queue is the `take_statue_spawns` event-queue seam:
`Wiring::switch_clicks: Vec<(i32, i32)>` fills in play order inside
`hit_switch` (world pixels; the queue itself draws NOTHING), and each app
drain site plays on its own stage's stream immediately after the triggering
pass вЂ” the C# draws mid-walk, the port drains at the pass tail (the same
deviation wave C recorded for the projectile strikes).

### Deliberate deviations / deferrals

- **The `KillWall` fail-path plays are missing.** The C# plays the sound table
  even when the break fails (`KillWall_CheckFailure` `:60410-60421`: the
  dungeon walls `{7,8,9,94-99}` before Skeletron, wall 87 before Golem вЂ”
  `Main.cs:10598-10606`; `Player.PickWall` calls `KillWall(fail: true)` on
  every sub-100 damage tick, `Player.cs:45957`). The port's `break_wall` has
  no fail parameter and no hit-tile damage model, so the cue rides the
  successful break only. The fail gating needs the `hitTile` damage
  accumulator + the progression flags вЂ” a follow-up, not this wave.
- **The explosion wall-walk plays are deferred (E21h-owned).**
  `Projectile.ExplodeTiles`' 3Г—3 wall walk calls `WorldGen.KillWall`
  (`Projectile.cs:78745`) under the `UpdateProjectiles` swap
  (`Main.cs:17775`); the port's walk (`projectile.rs` explode_bomb) calls
  `tr_core::edit::break_wall` directly with no sound. That file belongs to
  the projectile wave вЂ” recorded here, not touched.
- **The load-rig `TR_TOGGLES` path stays log-only** (`app/mod.rs`
  `apply_tr_toggles`): no player exists at load, the C# `gameMenu`/loading
  gate would refuse the positioned plays anyway.
- **The wiring arm order differs from the C#.** The port groups
  135/314/423/428/442/476 first and puts 210/443 before the 132/411 else-arm;
  the click pushes match each arm's C# position semantics regardless (441/468
  click at the clicked cell, NOT the derived trip corner; 467 only on the
  trigger variant).
- **The `kill_cue` D3 pin is untouched.** The landed tile-break wave's
  pinned/no-jitter mapping (`editing.rs::kill_cue`) stays as-is; the new
  wall/door/switch paths use the pitched RNG contract instead.
- **The case-28 playing guard is device-bound.** Headless (no output device)
  `emit` returns `None`, the slot stays empty and the guard never trips вЂ”
  every audible click draws, matching the fresh-instance behaviour. With a
  device, a live click refuses the next one draw-free (the C# semantics).
- **The door cue strings are unchanged** (`Door_Opened`/`Door_Closed`) вЂ” the
  existing `interaction_events` tests keep passing their shape; only the
  play path gained the pitch draw.
- **One borrow re-fetch in `world_sim/player.rs`**: the accessory buff-arms
  call re-fetches `stream(UpdatePlayers)` instead of reusing the tick's `rng`
  binding (the switch-click drains borrowed the pool in between) вЂ” the

## Test temp-path isolation (fix/test-temp-path-isolation, 2026-11-18)
**The race.** Disk-writing tests joined CONSTANT names onto
`std::env::temp_dir()` (`tr-s1-j-4-validate.trwld`, `tr-flow-char-fav`,
`tr-persist-v3.trwld`, вЂ¦). `%TEMP%` is per-user, not per-worktree: two gates
running `cargo test` concurrently in sibling worktrees share every one of
those paths вЂ” one gate's `remove_file`/`remove_dir_all` wipes the other's
in-flight fixture, producing spurious "file not found"/parse failures that
vanish on a serial re-run. The fix is test-code-only: every scratch output
moves into a unique per-test directory
`temp_dir()/tr-test-<pid>-<name>` (pid separates concurrent binaries, the
test slug separates tests inside one binary), created empty and removed
best-effort at the test's end. Committed fixtures (`assets/test/golden.*`)
keep their paths вЂ” only scratch outputs moved.
**The shared helper.** `crates/tr-app/src/test_world_helpers.rs` (the
existing test-utils module) gains `test_scratch(name)` (wipe-stale +
`create_dir_all`) and `remove_scratch(dir)` (errors ignored). The local
`scratch`/`ach_scratch` (saveglue) and `temp_dir` (save_list) helpers now
delegate to it; `tr-core`'s `wld/mod.rs` scratch helper already keyed on
pid + name and stays local (tr-core cannot depend on tr-app).
**Census вЂ” fixed constant paths (all fixed, pre-fix file:line):**
- `crates/tr-app/src/achievements.rs:914` (`tr-ach-test.trdat`)
- `crates/tr-app/src/app/flow.rs:2040` (`terrustaria-delete-gate.trwld`),
  `:2481` (`tr-flow-char-fav`)
- `crates/tr-app/src/app/mod.rs:4955` (`tr-dw-1-6-pins.trwld`), `:5004`
  (`tr-dw-1-6-clear.trwld`)
- `crates/tr-app/src/app/saveglue.rs:955, 1192, 1242, 1289, 1328, 1373,
  1431, 1458, 1498, 1594, 1637` (the DW-2.x / S1-J-4 / S1-J-7 round-trip
  files)
- `crates/tr-app/src/persist.rs:163, 195, 211, 227, 242` (the sidecar
  version fixtures)
- `crates/tr-app/src/ui/save_list.rs:453-454` (the fixed-name `temp_dir`
  helper; callers `:526, 557, 582, 630, 645, 740, 797, 818, 972`), plus
  `:575` (`tr-savelist-nope`) and `:634` (`tr-savelist-noplayers`) вЂ” the
  two missing-dir probes now point at an absent child of a unique dir
- `crates/tr-app/src/ui/world_creation.rs:1501, 1532`;
  `crates/tr-app/src/ui/world_select.rs:1417`
**Census вЂ” already pid-unique (safe across gates, left as-is):**
`assets.rs:3115, 3140`; `app/worldgen_job.rs:265, 308`;
`app/mod.rs:4591, 4655, 4673`; `app/flow.rs:2988`; `map.rs:882`;
`ui/ingame_options.rs:2319`; `tr-core/src/wld/mod.rs:1151`; saveglue's
`scratch`/`ach_scratch` (`:417, :1666`, now delegating). `tools/` uses
Python `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory`/`mkdtemp` (`GenItemData/gen.py:3035`,
`GenItemData/test_gen.py:20`, `GenSortData/gen.py:372`) вЂ” already unique.
No `%TEMP%` literals or hardcoded `Temp` paths exist in test code.
**Code-only note.** Written under the swarm's code-only directive: no
cargo/rustc/rustfmt/test runs, no compiler invoked; style matched by hand.
Concurrency verification is DEFERRED to the compile window вЂ” run the same
filter twice in parallel, once per worktree (PowerShell):
```powershell
Start-Job -Name gateA { Set-Location 'C:\Users\DreadLord\Desktop\TR-tmpfix';
    cargo test -p tr-app --bin terraria-rust saveglue 2>&1 }
Start-Job -Name gateB { Set-Location 'C:\Users\DreadLord\Desktop\<sibling-worktree>';
    cargo test -p tr-app --bin terraria-rust saveglue 2>&1 }
Receive-Job gateA -Wait; Receive-Job gateB -Wait
# both must print `test result: ok` (cargo may exit 1 on success here вЂ”
# judge only by the result lines). Repeat with the filters `persist`,
# `savelist`, `worldcreate`, `dw_1_6` and finally the full gate:
# cargo test --workspace -- --skip migrates_version_2_kinds_to_item_ids
```

# INTENT: ANALYSIS note for S1-I-4 wave C (task/S1-I-4c)
Append near the "Projectile + strike sync (M6-NET-5)" section
(`docs/ANALYSIS.md:9364`):
## Projectile SendData cadence (S1-I-4 wave C)
`app/net_proj_sync.rs` ports the projectile sync's three cadences as pure
functions (`ProjSync`), disjoint from `netglue.rs` (wave A) and
`net_npc_sync.rs` (wave B):
- **Spawn** (`Projectile.cs:11096`): one `27` per `NewProjectile`, after
  `FinalizeProjectile` + the modifier; the only gate is `SendData`'s
  `netMode == 0` return (`NetMessage.cs:83-86`).
- **Kill** (`Projectile.cs:77254-77257`): one `29` when
  `owner == Main.myPlayer && netMode != 0`, carrying the **entry** position
  snapshot (`:70648`), not the death position.
- **Per-update** (`Projectile.cs:17210-17244`): the `netUpdate`/`netSpam`
  budget РІР‚вЂќ cost 5, cap 60, refill 1/tick РІР‚вЂќ runs **per sub-step** (inside the
  `while` at `:16676`, `1 + extraUpdates` times); the `netUpdate = false`
  tail (`:17244`) is outside the loop and the owner gate, so it clears every
  slot's flag every tick. A parked send (`netUpdate2`) promotes and retries
  next tick.
- **Section culling** (`NetMessage.cs:1774-1800`): flag3 (`type == 12 ||
  projPet || aiStyle == 11 || netImportant`, `:1777`) bypasses culling;
  skipped clients are remembered per slot and re-served by
  `RecheckSectionsForSkippedUpdates` (`Projectile.cs:17246-17256`, host
  only), the targeted send clearing the flag (`NetMessage.cs:1821-1823`).
**Deliberate deviations (until the wave merge):**
1. The engine is **dead-code parity** (the R-36-2 film-framework pattern):
   the live loop still runs `netglue.rs::projectile_sync_plan`'s 10 Hz diff.
   Wiring both would double-send; the swap is the merge follow-up.
2. The 337 C# `netUpdate = true` AI-arm producers are not wired РІР‚вЂќ the port's
   AI arms skip the writes today; `ProjSync::mark_dirty` is the seam.
3. `bannerIdToRespondTo` rides as 0 (no pool field; the banner response is
   unported) and `Main.projPet` is a `false` parameter (no port table yet).
4. The per-slot bookkeeping lives beside the pool (`ProjSync`) instead of on

## The net sync swap (S1-I-4d, code-only mode, 2026-11-19)

The wave-B (`net_npc_sync.rs`) and wave-C (`net_proj_sync.rs`) decision layers
landed INERT (zero callers). This wave SWAPS them into the live loop and DELETES
the old duplicate sends — wiring both would double-send, so the swap is atomic.

**What was removed (the old paths):**
- `netglue.rs::net_tick`'s whole-set 10 Hz `23 NPCInfo` broadcast (one message per
  live NPC every cadence tick) — replaced by the per-NPC `netSpam` cadence.
- `netglue.rs::projectile_sync_plan` (the 10 Hz `27` change-diff + the vanished-key
  `29` feed) and its `App.net_proj_last` / `net_proj_spam` maps — replaced by
  `ProjSync`'s faithful budget.
- The client's absence-from-the-stream despawn prune (`App.net_npc_seen`,
  `net_npcs_seen_at`, the `NPC_STALE` const) — the event-driven `23` stream has no
  "whole set" to diff against; despawns are explicit life-0 bodies now.

**What was wired (the new paths):**
- `App::npc_sync_cadence` (host-only, `NPC.cs:90590`) steps
  `net_npc_sync::update_network_code` per NPC per fixed step, in slot order
  (`Main.cs:17948-17952`). State is keyed by the stable `Npc.uid` (the port's Vec
  compacts on death, so the index is not stable). `App::flush_npc_outbox` drains
  the `NpcSend` outbox through `S2c::NpcInfo` / `NpcHouse` / `NpcBuffs`.
- `App::proj_sync_cadence` steps `net_proj_sync::ProjSync` per fixed step
  (`Projectile.cs:17210-17244`); spawn `27` (`:11096`), kill `29` with the entry
  position (`:77254-77257`, `:70648`), and the budget pass. `App::drain_proj_outbox`
  sends through `S2c::Projectile` / `ProjectileDead` (host) or `C2s` (client).
- Both cadences run on a 60 Hz accumulator (`App.net_sync_cadence_timer`) inside
  `net_tick`, so the real frame loop AND the net-only test pump drive them; the
  outboxes drain on the 10 Hz tick. The message-id table (S1-I-1) is UNCHANGED.

**Swap proof (no double-send):** each subsystem has exactly ONE producer now.
The NPC `23` comes only from `npc_sync_cadence` → `flush_npc_outbox` (the old
broadcast loop is gone); the projectile `27`/`29` only from `proj_sync_cadence` →
`drain_proj_outbox` (`projectile_sync_plan` is gone). Within the projectile
cadence the spawn site and the change-detect producer are disjoint (the `fresh`
set skips first-sight), so a spawn emits ONE `27`, not two. Witnesses:
`the_npc_cadence_sends_once_then_throttles_not_every_tick`,
`the_proj_cadence_spawn_sends_one_27_not_two`,
`the_npc_cadence_throttles_a_moving_npc_to_the_netSpam_rate` (cadence parity),
`the_npc_despawn_streams_one_life0_body_and_the_client_drops_it` (stream-order).

**Deliberate deviations / interim stand-ins (recorded, not silent):**
1. **Interim change-detect producers.** The C# `netUpdate = true` comes from ~337
   projectile AI sites + the NPC AI arms. The NPC arms already set
   `Npc.net_update`; one projectile producer is wired (the gem-staff retarget,
   `Projectile.cs:37891`, via the new `Projectile.net_update` field). Until the
   full census lands, a state change vs the last body ALSO arms the dirty flag
   (`npc_sync_cadence` / `proj_sync_cadence`), so moving entities still sync. The
   send BUDGET is the faithful C# gate, not the diff — the diff only decides
   *whether* to dirty, the `netSpam` throttle decides *when* to send.
2. **The despawn feed** is the uid gone-diff (a uid the cadence knew that left the
   live set emits one life-0 `23`), not the C#'s per-slot `active=false` — the
   port's Vec removes dead NPCs, so the cadence (not the removed slot) emits it.
   The client removes on life≤0 with a generation guard (`MessageBuffer.cs:1661`).
3. **Hostile shots (owner 255)** are out of the projectile budget sync (the owner
   gate matches `Projectile.cs:17210` and the old diff's scope). On the C# server
   `Main.myPlayer == 255` folds them in; the port's host keeps a local player
   (owner 0), so hostile-shot sync lands with the owner-model reconcile.
4. **`has_head_index`** rides `NpcKind::is_town_npc()` (the town roster) until the
   `TypeToDefaultHeadIndex` table lands (`NPC.cs:90621`).
5. **The event-site helpers** (`sync_now`, `recheck_sections`, `note_broadcast`,
   `despawn_mark_applies`) stay dead-code-parity until their simulation callers
   land; the cadence's section culling rides the decision layer's own fan-out.

layers' landed per-site tests (`net_npc_sync` 20, `net_proj_sync` 10) plus the
four new wiring witnesses are the tests-as-code. C# cross-reads cited per block.

## The player-state / container / tile-edit send cadences (W4-c28, code-only mode, 2026-11-21)

S1-I-4's remaining send families. The projectile cadence already landed (wave C/D,
`net_proj_sync` wired at 60 Hz); this wave maps the player-state, container and
tile-edit cadences and swaps the player-state one into the live loop.

**Player-state (`net_player_sync.rs`, the SWAP).** The C# client fans its own state
over three paths, ported as pure decision functions and drained through the existing
wires at 10 Hz (the decisions run at 60 Hz on `App.net_sync_cadence_timer`):
- `Player.TrySyncingInput` (`Player.cs:6852-6916`, called `:6732`): the 12-field
  compare vs `Main.clientPlayer`; ONE `13` per changed tick.
- `Main.TrySyncingMyPlayer` (`Main.cs:17545-17703`, called `:17192` at netMode 1):
  the `5` array diffs FIRST (`:17547-17574`), then the scalar tail in source order —
  `33` close-flush, `40`, `36`, `16`/`42` (60-tick `netLife`/`netMana` throttles),
  `50`+`13`, `99`/`115`, three separate `13`s (direction/shield/snapstone), `138`.
- `Main.UpdateClient` (`Main.cs:64516-64553`): `netPlayCounter++` wrap `>3600`;
  `%420` → one `13`; `%900` → `36`,`16`,`40` in that order.
The old 10 Hz change-test + 42-call heartbeat (`netglue.rs::net_tick`, `net_beat`,
`NET_HEARTBEAT_TICKS`) is DELETED — wiring both would double-send.

**Fidelity decisions (re-derived from source, over the in-flight draft):**
1. `ClientClone` starts at `new Player()` (`Main.cs:67158`): `statLife=statLifeMax=100`
   (`Player.cs:1924-1928`), `statMana=0`/`statManaMax=20` (`:1930`+ctor), `direction=1`
   (`Entity.cs:20`), `chest=-1` (`:2876`), `talkNPC=-1` (ctor), `MinionAttackTargetNPC=-1`
   (`:3008`) — NOT an all-zero Default, so a zero-hp player compares different on tick 1.
2. The `33` close body carries the LIVE (negative) chest index, so the writer's
   `number > -1` coord read (`NetMessage.cs:884-889`) never runs — x/y are 0/0. The
   named arm's text reads `Main.chest[player.chest]` — the CLONE's chest (`Main.cs:17581`),
   with the null-slot nameless fallback (`:17585-17587`).
3. Missing clone-item entries compare as AIR (`clientCloneItem` starts `new Item()`,
   `Player.cs:54517-54523`) — kills the join-time `5`-spam on every empty slot.
4. The render-extension `13` snapshots at DECISION time, not per 60 Hz step until the
   10 Hz drain (else 6 duplicate sends per change).
5. `chest::tick_open`'s S1-P-i43 close-flush is REMOVED — the cadence owns the `33`;
   `HandleBeingInChestRange` (`Player.cs:31015-31097`) has no SendData. The
   `prev_synced_chest` snapshot still updates (the open-click flush's name fallback).

**Container (`32 SyncChestItem`, event-driven).** The port had the host-side `32`
handler but NO client send path. Wired the C#'s per-changed-slot sends:
`send_chest_item` (the `NetMessage.cs:864-877` body read back from the store;
client-only, world chests only — banks ride the `5` sync) + `send_chest_item_diff`
(the bulk-pass stamp diff, `ChestUI.cs:813-819` / `ItemSorting.cs:1673-1678`). Sites:
`ItemSlot.cs:1014` left-click, `:1750` right-click split, `:808` shift-take,
`:3359-3362` SwapEquip tail, the HasItemSwap cycle; ChestUI's bulk transfers
(LootAll/DepositAll/QuickStack/Restock via the post-pass diff) and SortChest;
`chest::try_placing_from`'s shift-deposit (pre-pass snapshot diff).

**Tile-edit (event-driven immediate).** `WorldGen.KillTile`/`PlaceTile`'s
`SendData(17)`/`SendTileSquare` fire at the EDIT SITE (`Player.cs:53783`/`:40152`,
`WorldGen.cs:63937`), not on a timer. The port's `request_edit` already sends the
client `Edit` immediately (`client.send` pushes straight to the wire buffer); the
10 Hz `net_tick` carries no tile-edit batch. A witness pins the no-cadence-tick send.

**Deliberate deviations / unported bodies (recorded, not silent):**
1. **The render-extension `13`.** The C# server simulates every peer's movement from
   the relayed controls and derives anim/hp locally; the port simulates remote players
   nowhere, so a change in the wire body's position/anim/hp extension arms one more

2. **Unported control channels.** `controlDownHold`/`controlDash`/`isOperatingAnotherEntity`/

4. **The `5` array layout** is the port's 40-slot-bank subset of `PlayerItemSlotID`
   (`client_send_identity`'s layout), NOT the C#'s full 200-slot banks + loadouts.

## The residual send-triggers (W4-c28 continuation, code-only mode, 2026-11-21)

The cadence-residual pass over the remaining `SendData` families vs C# Main. The
NPC-sync cadence (`net_npc_sync`, S1-I-4d) was verified already wired at 60 Hz
(`npc_sync_cadence` → `update_network_code` per NPC, host-only); the mana/health
`16`/`42` 60-tick throttles + the `UpdateClient` 900-tick trio were verified already
in the `net_player_sync` tail. The MISSING send-triggers ported this pass:

**NPC buff `53`/`54` (`NPC.AddBuff`, `NPC.cs:89926-89983`).** The decision layer
(`net_npc_sync::add_buff`) existed but nothing called it. The buff engine now queues
each accepted (type,time) pair at the write point (`NpcBuffs::net_sends`);
`drain_npc_buff_sends` picks the wire by role — client one `53` per pair
(`NPC.cs:89932-89935`, through the host slot map), host one `54` full list per touched
NPC (`:89979-89982`). Drains ride the sim-pass tails that mutate NPC buffs (the melee
hit `editing.rs`, the projectile pass, the player-tick retaliate) plus a 60 Hz net-step
catch-all for the AI/timer lane. The `case 53` handler clears the queue (its own `54`
IS the fan-out, `quiet:true` `MessageBuffer.cs:2570`). The host's per-AddBuff `54` is
coalesced to one per touched NPC per pass (the list body is identical within a pass —
the last write wins, the same bytes; recorded deviation).

**Player hurt `16` (`Player.Hurt`, `Player.cs:38369-38377`).** The `hurt_sends` decision
helper existed but had no caller. The accepted hurt now queues `(knockback_13, hp,
max_hp)` at the hit moment — the hp pair is the PRE-subtraction `statLife` (the C#
sends at `:38375` before `statLife -= num2` at `:38383`), the `13` gate is the C#'s
three-clause `!noKnockback && hitDirection != 0 && (!mount.Active || !mount.Cart)`.
`player_sync_cadence` drains the queue ahead of the clone-compare so the `13`/`16` ride
the outbox in the C# order.

**Buff `55` (`Player.AddBuff` remote-peer branch, `Player.cs:5269-5275`).** c27 landed
the `55` body + apply/relay arms but NOT the client send. Ported the decision as
`net_player_sync::add_buff_remote_pvp`: a buff aimed at a non-local player returns
without applying locally, sending `55` only when `Main.pvpBuff[type]` (`:5271-5274`),
else dropping (`:5275`); the local path falls through to the normal apply. The
`PlayerSend::BuffPvp` intent carries the decision; the drain PARKS it until c27's
`PlayerBuffPvp` wire merges (the `36`/`35`/`40`/`84` precedent — recorded, not silent).

**Section-request `9` announce (`RemoteClient.CheckSection`, `RemoteClient.cs:126-188`).**
The move-driven catch-up streamed the missing sections but never announced them. Ported
the one `9 Status` before the `SendSection` walk (`:177-181`, `Lang.inter[44]`) carrying
the fluff-box missing count. The client's load-status count now rides the `GetData` head
(`MessageBuffer.cs:144-147` counts EVERY received message), the `9` writer ACCUMULATES
the max (`:880` `StatusMax += ReadInt32`), and the completion walk clears the status
(`Netplay.cs:528-533`) + on disconnect (`:573-575`).

## The aiStyle-14 flyer family (S1-D-3 aiStyle-14 slice, 2026-11-18, code-only mode)
`npc_ai_style14.rs::bat_ai` ports `NPC.AI()`'s `if (this.aiStyle == 14)`
arm (`NPC.cs:22849-23486`) with the branches the port's four style-14 kinds
take (CaveBat 49, JungleBat 51, Hellbat 60, VoodooDemon 66 вЂ” the
`SetDefaults` rows `:9378`/`:9409`/`:9543`/`:9629`; the C# arm serves
17 types). **Code-only mode**: no cargo/rustc/rustfmt/test runs were made
(user directive); verification = re-reading the C# arm line by line, the 14
`s1_d_3_s14_*` witness tests are WRITTEN NOT RUN. The module is UNWIRED вЂ”
the live dispatch still routes the four kinds through `update_cave_bat`'s
hash-jitter stand-in (research/25 finding 25-6); every other file is
byte-identical except the `mod` declaration and the docs.
Faithful details worth pinning:
- **The generic approach runs twice** for the water-group types
  (`:23183`'s list): the second pass (`:23265-23331`) sits OUTSIDE the
  `base.wet` gate, so a dry bat accelerates at 0.2/tick X, not 0.1 вЂ” the
  stand-in's single pass was a real behavioural delta, not just an RNG one.
  The Hellbat (60) instead follows the first pass with its own arm
  (`:23198-23263`: X 0.07 double-add / 0.03 brake, Y 0.02 brake).
- **The bounce clamps are direction-aware** (`:22855-22862`): the В±2 X
  minimum applies only when the bounce pushes AGAINST `direction`; the
  В±1 Y minimum (`:22867-22874`) is unconditional on sign.
- **The drift reset gate** (`:23363`) needs `!player.wet` AND the
  entity-box `Collision.CanHit`; `Player.wet` is not on
  `TargetCandidate` (the target scan never reads it), so it rides the
  module's parallel `players_wet` slice вЂ” the minimal seam.
- **The shot is a request, not a spawn**: `DemonSickleShot` carries the
  centre + the 0.2-normalised jittered velocity; `NewProjectile(44, 21,
  0f)` and the `timeLeft = 300` write (`:23449-23450`) belong to the
  wiring step's pool drain.
- **`noGravity`** (`:22851`) is structural: `Npc` has no field; the
  flyer callers integrate without gravity (the `update_hover`
  convention). `spriteDirection` is not written by this arm вЂ” the C#
  `TargetClosest` writes `direction`/`directionY` only; the renderer
  sync lands with the wiring.
**RNG argument (by construction)**: the arm's only `Main.rand` sites on
the ported paths are the 62/66 shot arm's вЂ” `Next(-100, 101)` for the X
aim jitter then the Y (`:23446-23447`, in that order, only on
`ai[0] == 20/40/60/80` with `CanHit`), and `Next(300)` inside the
reset threshold `(float)(300 + Main.rand.Next(300))` (`:23453`), drawn
only when the `flag24 &&` short-circuit passes AND the tick is not a
shot-value tick (the else-if). `TargetClosest` (`NPC.cs:77652-77781`)
is RNG-free. The bat kinds 49/51/60 therefore draw NOTHING вЂ” the witness
tests pin the stream position (`UnifiedRandom::peek`) for: two ordered
draws on a shot tick, one draw on an in-view reset tick, zero draws
out-of-view, zero draws on a blocked shot tick (the else-if is not
evaluated), and 600 draw-free ticks per bat kind incl. the wet arm.
**Cited skips** (unported types, land with their kinds): 226's
velocity-sign facing + 4/2.5 approach (`:22876-22894`, `:22971-23037`),
158's surface flee + 7-cap approach + Transform(159) + double `ai[1]++`
(`:22899-22970`, `:23346-23360`), 660's 0.35/0.3/6/5 approach
(`:23038-23115`), 48's wet arm + HarpyFeather shot (`:23333-23345`,
`:23416-23436`), 156's UnholyTrident shot (`:23458-23484`).

## The aiStyle-51 census audit (S1-D-3, code-only mode)
**Code-only mode**: this task ran with NO compiler invoked вЂ” no cargo, no
rustc, no rustfmt, no tests run, no graphify refresh. Every claim below is
verified by reading the C# and the Rust side by side, not by execution.
**Census (the first check)**: `aiStyle = 51` appears exactly ONCE in the
NPC `SetDefaults` census вЂ” `NPC.cs:12384`, type **262 Plantera**
(`ID/NPCID.cs:11201`), row `:12379-12395` (86Г—86, dmg 50 / def 14 /
lifeMax 30000, kb 0, value `Item.buyPrice(0, 15)` = 150000
(`Item.cs:49417-49420`), noGravity + noTileCollide, boss, npcSlots 16).
No named-constant assignments (`aiStyle = NPCAIStyleID.*`) exist in
`NPC.cs`. The two other `aiStyle = 51` hits are **projectile** styles вЂ”
`Projectile.cs:3830` (type 293 `LostSoulHostile`) and `:3874` (type 297
`LostSoulFriendly`, `ID/ProjectileID.cs:1140`/`:1148`) вЂ” a different
machine, S1-D-4's territory, out of the NPC census. The satellites ride
OTHER styles: Hook 263 в†’ 52 (`NPC.cs:12402`), Tentacle 264 в†’ 53
(`:12414`), Spore 265 в†’ 50 (`:12427`); Brain of Cthulhu 266 в†’ 54
(`:12443`, S1-D-3e's census, untouched). **Verdict: Plantera only в†’ this
task is a docs-only census audit of the sibling's coverage; no new code.**
**The sibling under audit**: `ba8159fc` (`task/S1-D-3-plantera-audit`,
pushed, NOT in `origin/main` at audit time вЂ” `git merge-base
--is-ancestor ba8159fc origin/main` exits 1). It ports the machine to
`crates/tr-app/src/npc_ai_plantera.rs` (604 lines, 11 witness tests
WRITTEN NOT RUN) and wires the kind-262 seam. The distrust-verbatim
re-read of the whole arm (`NPC.cs:31717-32075`) against that module
confirms the bulk of the port (the tuning ladder `:31763-31808`, the
500-px leash + in-band hover quirk `:31799-31831`, the reversal-Г—2
approach `:31832-31863`, the phase stats 36/50 Г—2 and 10/70 defГ—4 dmgГ—2
`:31866-31875`/`:31973-31980`, the >80 seed cadence with the f64
0.9/0.8/0.7/0.6 bumps + enrage +3 `:31880-31917`, the 22/275 в†’
27/276 (`Next(4)`, в€’30) в†’ 31/277 (`Next(8)`, в€’120) volley with the
`<0.8`-gated else-if short-circuit `:31937-31957`, the Г—3 muzzle
`:31963-31964`, timeLeft 300 unless 277 `:31966-31969`, the one-shot
8-tentacle latch `:31983-31994`, the в‰Ґ350 spore cadence with the f64
0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1 bumps `:32037-32054`, the X-first В±10 jitters
`:32058`/`:32060`) вЂ” but finds these gaps:
* **G1 вЂ” the rotation atan2 is SWAPPED (behavioural defect).**
  `NPC.cs:31865` is `Math.Atan2(x: playerCX в€’ cx, y: playerCY в€’ cy) +
  1.57f`. The NAMED arguments bind dx to `Atan2(double y, double x)`'s
  **x-parameter** and dy to its **y-parameter** вЂ” the value is the
  STANDARD `atan2(dy, dx)`, computed in double, cast to float BEFORE the
  `+1.57f`. The sibling (`npc_ai_plantera.rs:170-172`) reads the named
  args as positional and ports `dx.atan2(dy)`; its comment ("the
  arguments are SWAPPED vs the usual atan2(dy, dx); ported verbatim")
  and its witness test `the_rotation_uses_the_swapped_atan2` (`:530-537`)
  pin the WRONG value. Player directly right (dx=100, dy=0): C# в†’
  `atan2(0,100) = 0` в†’ rotation 1.57; sibling в†’ `atan2(100,0) = ПЂ/2` в†’
  в‰€3.14. The boss head's roll is wrong on every tick. Fix wave: swap to
  `dy.atan2(dx)` through f64 (`((dy as f64).atan2(dx as f64)) as f32 +
  1.57`) and repoint the witness.
* **G2 вЂ” the spore lift condition is INVERTED (behavioural defect).**
  `NPC.cs:32059-32065`: `num773 = |num772 * 0.2|`; `if (num774 > 0)
  num773 = 0;` then `num774 -= num773` вЂ” the upward lead is subtracted
  ONLY when the jittered dy в‰¤ 0 (target at/above the boss); a target
  below gets NO lift. The sibling (`:414-420`) computes the lead
  correctly but writes `if dy > 0.0 { dy -= lead; }` вЂ” the exact
  opposite gate (its own comment describes the C# correctly; the code
  contradicts it). No witness test covers the spore aim, so the 11
  tests do not catch it.
* **G3 вЂ” the gore burst consumes 6 of the C#'s 12 RNG draws (stream
  drift).** `NPC.cs:32028-32030` draws `Next(width)` then `Next(height)`
  per gore (the sibling ports these, `:394-401`), but `Gore.NewGore`
  itself then draws `Next(10, 31)` (the vy kick) and `Next(-20, 21)`
  (the vx kick) per gore (`Gore.cs:1327-1328`) вЂ” 6 more draws the
  sibling skips with the emit ("documented skip, Brain precedent").
  The ChildSafety re-roll (`Gore.cs:1334-1340`) never fires
  (`ChildSafety.Disabled = true`, `GameContent/ChildSafety.cs:33`), and
  the full-pool early-out that would skip the velocity draws
  (`Gore.cs:1317-1320`) is unreachable in practice (600 slots vs a
  3-gore burst). The shared `Main.rand` stream therefore drifts by 6
  draws at the one-shot shell-break tick (`localAI[2]` latch). The
  sibling's ANALYSIS row "RNG order preserved (2 draws per gore)" is
  inaccurate вЂ” the true order is 4 per gore. Fix wave: draw the two
  kicks per gore (or emit fully-rolled gore requests the wiring inserts
  without re-rolling).
* **G4 вЂ” the first-tick NaN claim is wrong (doc inaccuracy).** The
  sibling's ANALYSIS says the C# "would divide by a zero hook count on
  the very first tick before its own spawns resolve". `NPC.NewNPC`
  activates the slot synchronously (`NPC.cs:80767-80771`,
  `active = true`), and the three hook spawns (`:31739-31741`) run
  BEFORE the centroid scan (`:31747`) in the same `AI()` call вЂ” the
  first tick sees 3 hooks. The 0/0 NaN centroid (`:31761-31762`) arises
  only when ALL hooks are later dead (or the roster was full at init).
  The port's own-centre fallback remains a valid documented stand-in
  either way; only the justification is wrong.
* **G5 вЂ” minor precision seam.** The C#'s distance/aim norms are
  `(float)Math.Sqrt(f32 sum)` вЂ” double sqrt of the f32-promoted sum,
  cast back (`:31799`/`:31820`/`:31934`/`:32066`); the sibling uses f32
  `.sqrt()` throughout (в‰¤1-ulp divergence per call). Same class as
  G1's double-atan2 cast. Recorded for the fix wave, not a structural
  defect.
**Recorded skips confirmed acceptable** (the sibling documents them):
`TargetClosest` (`:31721`) rides the passed-player convention (the
S1-D-3p migration is its own catalog row); the `timeLeft` refresh
(`:31727-31734`, `NPC.activeTime = 750` `:95186`) and `NPC.plantBoss`

(single-difficulty classic вЂ” note the ftw wiring wave must also account

`NPC.cs:80752`); the net-client early returns (`:31876`/`:32033`) fold
out at netMode 0; the stand-in's world-bottom despawn tail is kept as
